Mud and sand buried the fallen trees, layer on layer, and shut the air out.

npcs.name: Receptionist
dialog: Welcome to the Oreburgh Mining Museum!
Everything here came up out of our own mine. Please take your time.

npcs.name: Schoolboy
dialog: The mine goes on and on under the ground, right out beneath the sea!
I asked how they keep the water out. Nobody would tell me. I think it's a secret.

npcs.name: Hiker
dialog: A lump of coal that size! You could warm the whole of Oreburgh through a winter with it.
Well. Half a winter. Our winters are long.

npcs.name: Girl
dialog: It's black and it shines. Is it a jewel? Granddad says it's better than a jewel.
You can't keep warm with a jewel, he says.

npcs.name: Breeder
dialog: Have you met the Underground Man in Eterna City? He knows everything about digging.
He'll give you a kit of your own, if you ask. Then you can dig up Fossils yourself!

npcs.name: Old Man
dialog: I went down that mine at fifteen and came up for good at sixty.
The town was built on what we dug. Mind you remember that, when you look at these old tools.
